photos.desc: Fragment of the mandibular symphysis of a tapejarid pterosaur (BSP 1997 I 67) from the Kem Kem Group in (A) ?left lateral, (B) ?right lateral and (C) dorsal (occlusal) view. Scale bar equals 5 cm.

An illustration of Spinosaurus and mainly the many aquatic animals it lived with, also with some speculation. Species listed here: https://www.deviantart.com/mikathekomododragon/art/The-Pharaohs-Aquar
